shortDescription: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Sept. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Rubicon Organics Inc. children: (“Rubicon Organics” or the “Company”), Canada’s leading premium licensed producer focused on cultivating and selling premium and super-premium cannabis products, is pleased to announce its participation in investor and industry conferences across Canada this fall, including the SmallCap Discoveries Conference in Vancouver; Planet Microcap Toronto 2026; Science in the City International in Paris, France; and the 2026 CanExec Summit in Toronto.

"This fall’s conference schedule provides important opportunities to strengthen relationships with the investment community, engage with industry leaders, and elevate awareness of Rubicon Organics’ differentiated position in the global cannabis market,” said Margaret Brodie, Chief Executive Officer. “As we continue to execute our growth strategy, these forums allow us to showcase the strength of our premium brand portfolio, our expanding production capabilities, and our disciplined approach to pursuing select international opportunities.”

Ms. Brodie will present to investors at the SmallCap Discoveries Conference in Vancouver on September 29, 2026, and at Planet MicroCap Toronto on October 28, 2026. A webcast of the Planet MicroCap presentation will be available live and for replay via the link below. Rubicon Organics will also host one-on-one investor meetings at both events with Ms. Brodie and Glen Ibbott, Chief Financial Officer.

Rubicon Organics will also support Science in the City International as the educational sponsor. The cannabis industry symposium will be held September 28-29, 2026, in Paris, France, where Mathieu Aubin, Vice President, Marketing & New Business, will speak on the future of medical cannabis in France.

In October, Rubicon Organics will participate in the sixth annual CanExec Summit in Toronto, an exclusive networking and educational event for decision-makers from leading licensed producers. Melanie Ramsey, Chief Operating Officer, will participate in a panel on “The Cannabis Landscape: Building a Stronger Industry,” and Mr. Aubin will join the panel “Building a Global Cannabis Business” to discuss international opportunities.

Rubicon Organics is the Canadian leader in certified organic and premium cannabis. With a vertically integrated model and strong national distribution, the company is scaling a house of trusted, high-performing brands including Simply Bare™ Organics, 1964 Supply Co.™, Wildflower™, and Homestead Cannabis Supply™.

The Company operates two complementary cultivation facilities in British Columbia: the flagship 125,000-square-foot Pacifica hybrid greenhouse in Delta and the 47,500-square-foot Cascadia indoor facility in Hope. Cascadia is now fully planted and operational, contributing to Rubicon’s total current annual production capacity of approximately 15,500 kilograms of premium cannabis.
With proprietary genetics, award-winning products, and certifications enabling international distribution, Rubicon is positioned at the forefront of the premium cannabis segment.

As the Canadian market continues to evolve and global demand for high-quality cannabis increases, Rubicon Organics’ disciplined execution, brand equity, and consumer loyalty set it apart. The Company’s continued focus on premium quality, thoughtful innovation, and operational excellence has supported steady revenue growth and positive Adjusted EBITDA.
Rubicon Organics represents a rare combination of category leadership, operational strength, and long-term growth potential.
